title: Fix GitHub Pages Vite base config
context: GitHub Pages deployment is failing because the Vite config incorrectly places `base` under `resolve.alias`, causing production assets to build with root-relative paths instead of the repo path.

tasks.title: Move Vite base to proper top-level config for GitHub Pages
acceptance_criteria: vite.config.ts uses a top-level `base` option instead of an alias entry
The base path matches the GitHub Pages repo path `/seanjones.io.ai/` for production builds
The alias config still preserves `@` for src imports
Built output references assets under `/seanjones.io.ai/` instead of `/assets/` at the site root
